grh_8fcceb4de3319e5a0b2d.title: No Crib For His Bed
paragraphs: Mary Bartlett is nearly penniless after her husband Ben leaves for Center City to find work soon after their baby's birth and sends only a single message in six weeks. Forced from her room and desperate to find him, Mary leaves the baby safely bundled at the bus station with a note asking someone to care for him while she walks into a Christmas snowstorm. Children from the church pageant discover the baby, while Dr. Christian travels to Center City and finds that Ben has finally secured steady work but was ashamed to write while he remained unemployed. On the return trip they find Mary collapsed in the snow and bring her back to Rivers End. The family is reunited at the Christmas pageant, where Mary discovers her own baby safe in the manger beneath the star of Bethlehem.

The cast includes Jean Hersholt, Rosemary De Camp, Helen Claire, Carl Frank, and Gloria Holden. Other credited names include Andre Baruch as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 29 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_8fedbf6d8bbbcd7663b7.title: My Maryland
paragraphs: In Civil War Frederick, Maryland, Barbara Frietchie loves Union Captain Will Trumbull despite her Confederate father's fierce opposition. Their planned wedding is interrupted by approaching battle, so Will gives Barbara his mother's ring and tells her to regard them as married before he marches away. When the wounded Will is brought to Barbara's house, she defies her father and shelters him. Stonewall Jackson's troops retake the town but leave the American flag flying, and Barbara and Will take that gesture as hope that their divided families and country can one day be whole again.

grh_8f63fb4beba86f17b198.title: Fair Stood the Wind for France
paragraphs: A wounded British airman crash-lands in occupied France and is hidden by a French family while recovering from severe injuries that eventually cost him an arm. As German pressure closes in, he forms a deep bond with the young woman Francoise and is helped by his surviving comrades and French allies. The fugitives make a dangerous journey toward Spain, repeatedly risking discovery. Near the border, O'Connor sacrifices himself to distract the authorities after Francoise is detained, allowing the airman and Francoise to escape the final stretch toward freedom together.

grh_8f0657c9d5037e96a058.title: The Great Gandolfo
paragraphs: A magician's cabinet illusion depends on twin sisters secretly exchanging places, but one twin is found murdered after a performance and the other disappears. Holmes learns that the dead woman had been working as a spy for the Great Gandolfo and wanted to quit after realizing Holmes was investigating him. Gandolfo killed her because she could expose him; Holmes locates the surviving twin, reconstructs the cabinet trick and closes in on the magician while Mycroft independently identifies the suspended cabinet as the hiding place used in the espionage scheme.

grh_8fff630b3bec693f3717.title: The Catskills Cover-Up
paragraphs: Filling in as social director at Mama Greenspan’s Catskills resort, Rocky stumbles over a nervous guest, a missing fortune and several people searching for Larry Greenspan.
